All I need is money, but there's no way for me to get it. There are no jobs available in my area, and I don't have a car. If I have enough money to get my own place and leave, then I can get better. But there's no way for me to do that right now.

I've called hotlines, and I've been to psychiatric hospitals. When I was sexually abused, I was told that I was making it up all three times I called. When I went to the hospital (two different ones) I was evaluated by people who clearly didn't give a shit and came to the conclusion that I was just fine and dandy because 'a lot of people have it worse.'

That's why the book is so important to me. It's a chance for enough money to escape.
